newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU extends deadline on Cardo/Thyssen merger probe.
newsitem.headline: EU extends deadline on Cardo/Thyssen merger probe.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it had extended the deadline for ruling on the merger of the rail brake systems businesses of Cardo AB and Thyssen AG after receiving a complete notification of the deal.

It said in a statement published in the Official Journal C332 of November 7 the notification became complete on October 28. The Commission has about a month from that date to clear the deal or start a four-month in-depth probe.

The Swedish engineering company and Thyssen of Germany first submitted their proposed joint venture to manufacture brake systems for rail vehicles on October 8. But the Commission found on October 22 that it did not have sufficient information, it said in the statement without elaborating.
The deal is being assessed under the merger regulation 4064/89 which bans creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
Third parties were again invited to comment within 10 days.
